description: This file defines a generic class 'VirtualizedGrouping' for managing virtualized list rendering with grouping, caching, and batch loading functionalities in a project related to Notesnook.

classes.name: VirtualizedGrouping
classes.description: A class for managing virtualized grouped list data with caching and batch loading.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a string key for an item index.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Determines if an item at a given index is a header or a regular item.

methods.name: cacheItem
methods.description: Retrieves cached item, group, and data at a specific index.

methods.name: item
methods.description: Fetches item, group, and data at a specific index, optionally using a batch operation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a batch of items asynchronously, managing grouping and visibility.

methods.name: batchLoader
methods.description: Manages pending batch loads to prevent duplicate requests.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears cache to maintain cache size limit.
